input_mode: diff-mode (no prior Blueprint version; full reads of new Plan + Tests + Validators)

ac_traceability_blueprint_to_plan.detail: Plan v1.0.0's AC cross-reference table maps all 19 Blueprint ACs (AC-FR-1-a through AC-FR-8-a) to one or more Plan tasks. Zero orphan ACs.

ac_traceability_plan_to_tests.detail: acceptance-tests.md v1.0.0 has one test specification per AC (19 specs). The AC coverage matrix at the document end re-verifies the 1:1 mapping. Zero ACs without tests.

ac_traceability_blueprint_to_validators.detail: phase-validators.md v1.0.0 distributes all 19 ACs across the 8 phases. Each phase declares which acceptance tests it verifies. AC-FR-1-a verified at Phase 3 (anti-slop content + markers); AC-FR-1-b through AC-FR-1-e at Phase 2; AC-FR-1-f at Phase 1 + Phase 4; AC-FR-2-a/b at Phase 1 + Phase 2; AC-FR-3-a/b/c at Phase 1 + Phase 2; AC-FR-4-a/b at Phase 4; AC-FR-5-a at Phase 3 + Phase 6; AC-FR-5-b at Phase 6; AC-FR-5-c at Phase 7 (provenance); AC-FR-6-a at Phase 7 (Gate 6 manual); AC-FR-7-a at Phase 5; AC-FR-8-a at Phase 7 (conditional).

phase_validator_to_plan_task_alignment.detail: Each of the 8 Plan phases has a corresponding phase validator entry. Validator pass criteria reference Plan task deliverables (e.g., Phase 2 validator's content-specific check #7 corresponds to Plan T-2-2 / T-2-9 / T-2-11 / T-2-16 deliverables).

supersession_discipline.detail: ADR-0005 honored throughout: Phase 5 + Phase 5 validator + AC-FR-7-a all verify KB-frontend-design/references/ remains untouched. No new ADRs supersede inherited ADRs (only ADR-0024 added; it does not supersede). INFO-001 from Architecture Audit acknowledged: any future revision of D-001 follows ADR-0005 supersession (ADR-0024 preserved; new ADR added).

scope_consistency.detail: Layer Scope (Claude Code only) consistently applied across artifacts: Blueprint marks 8 other layers N/A; Plan has no cross-layer dependencies; Tests are filesystem/audit-only; Validators reference only .claude/ paths.

test_to_validator_alignment.detail: Every acceptance test's verification layer aligns with a phase validator's automation hook. STRUCT tests align with bash + cc-audit; CONTENT tests align with bash grep + manual; MANUAL tests (AC-FR-5-c, AC-FR-6-a) align with Phase 7 user-verification gate.

issues.finding: 3 acceptance tests are MANUAL (AC-FR-5-c provenance; AC-FR-6-a voice; AC-FR-8-a conditional). For a feature with 19 ACs, 3 manual checks (~16%) is acceptable. The MANUAL checks are appropriately scoped (provenance is by design; voice requires editorial judgment; conditional satisfaction is honest).
issues.recommendation: No action. Recorded as observation. If future features have higher MANUAL density (e.g., >30%), consider whether content-pattern automation can replace some manual review.

audit_notes: First (and likely only) cross-artifact audit cycle for this feature. The single-layer scope and clean Architecture Audit verdict mean cross-artifact contradictions are unlikely.
Convergence-based termination not applicable (first cycle); 4-cycle cap unused.

The 2 INFO observations from Architecture Audit (INFO-001 documentation coupling; INFO-002 external Anthropic dependency) are both addressed in Plan: INFO-001 acknowledged in Open Items section; INFO-002 captured as scope expectation for Plan T-2-9 anti-slop reference file.
All 19 ACs traced through PRD → Blueprint → Plan → acceptance-tests → phase-validators. The traceability chain is complete and consistent.
